rca_of_issue: Reported bug: 'Expo Go could not open app — error kept showing.' RCA: Expo Go SDK-57 client expects patch versions expo>=57.0.20 and expo-router>=57.0.19; project was pinned at 57.0.19 / 57.0.18, so the Metro bundle handshake failed. Fix: `expo install --fix` bumped both to matching versions; `expo install --check` now reports 'Dependencies are up to date'. Verified: web preview loads cleanly, all major routes render, no console errors — no code regressions from the bump.
